Food Security and Livelihoods in Yemen
The programme will address urgent food security and livelihood needs among conflict- and climate-affected populations in Marib and Hadramout. It combines food security, livelihood recovery and women’s economic empowerment, with a particular focus on IDPs, female-headed households and other vulnerable groups. Support to income-generating activities, skills development, savings mechanisms and community structures will strengthen household resilience, reduce negative coping mechanisms and support greater self-reliance.
